test_navigate_to_media_page.title: Verify navigation to the Media page via the sidebar

steps.action: Click Media in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The address ends in /media and the date filter reads Today, its default.

test_select_date_filter.title: Verify selecting 'Last 30 Days' from the date filter dropdown

steps.action: Open Media and choose Last 30 Days in the date filter.
steps.expected: The date filter reads Last 30 Days instead of Today.

test_switch_to_grid_view.title: Verify switching from list to grid view

steps.action: Open Media, choose Last 30 Days and click the grid view button.
steps.expected: The grid button reads pressed and the items move from one column into several.

test_all_tab.title: Verify the All tab loads and shows content or empty state

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days and click the All tab.
steps.expected: The All tab is painted as selected and the page shows items or its empty state.

test_my_media_tab.title: Verify the My Media tab loads

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days and click the My Media tab.
steps.expected: The My Media tab is painted as selected and All is not.

test_shared_with_me_tab.title: Verify the Shared with me tab loads

steps.action: Open Media, set the date filter to Last 30 Days and click the Shared with me tab.
steps.expected: The Shared with me tab is painted as selected and the page shows items or its empty state.

steps.action: Open Media, choose Last 30 Days and note the first clip's name.
steps.expected: The list shows at least one item.

steps.action: Type that name in the search field and press Enter.
steps.expected: The list shows that item and nothing that does not carry the name (the search needs three characters or more; a shorter query is ignored by the page).
